buttons.outline: border border-[#B87333]/50 text-[#B87333] hover:bg-[#B87333]/10 transition-colors duration-300 font-medium px-8 py-4

components.Header: Sticky, z-50, Glassmorphism. Logo left, Nav center, CTA right.
components.Hero: Full viewport height. Background image with rgba(27,27,27,0.5) overlay. Center aligned text for maximum impact.
components.Section: Use Py-32 for vertical rhythm. Start with an Overline, then H2, then Body text.
components.PropertyCard: Image top (aspect-[4/3]), content bottom. Hover effect on image (slow scale). 1px border of copper/20.
components.Footer: Darker background or subtle top border. Large Typography for brand name. Minimal links.

hero.description: Biswa Bangla Gate at twilight - For Homepage Hero Section

backgrounds.description: Copper and charcoal abstract texture - For Lead Gen or Why Astitva section background

instructions_to_main_agent: Configure tailwind.config.js to include Poppins (headings) and Inter (body) fonts.
Add custom colors to Tailwind config: charcoal (#1B1B1B), copper (#B87333), rose-gold (#C68E6D), and warm-ivory (#F8F5F1).
Implement Framer Motion for elegant scroll animations, particularly on 'Why Astitva' and 'Featured Projects' sections. Keep it subtle and cinematic.
For the hero section, ensure the overlay is max `bg-[#1B1B1B]/50` to let the Biswa Bangla Gate shine through.
Do not use generic Shadcn cards for marketing sections; build custom HTML/Tailwind structures with 1px `border-[#B87333]/20` for a premium feel.
Implement the 'Future Expansion Roadmap' using a visual timeline or dynamic step layout rather than just text.
Ensure the Admin panel dashboard uses Shadcn components styled to match the dark luxury aesthetic (1px borders, subtle hover effects).
Add `data-testid` attributes to all interactive elements (e.g., `data-testid="explore-properties-btn"`).
Avoid bright generic startup colors completely. Stick strictly to the defined Charcoal/Copper/Rose-Gold/Ivory palette.
